𝐌𝐎𝐑𝐄 𝐏𝐎𝐖𝐄𝐑 𝐀𝐃𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐎𝐑𝐘: 𝐍𝐆𝐂𝐏 𝐑𝐄𝐃 𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐘𝐄𝐋𝐋𝐎𝐖 𝐀𝐋𝐄𝐑𝐓
Date: Friday, September 11, 2026
Ang Visayas Grid may kakulangan nga 1,030MW nga kuryente subong nga adlaw base sa NGCP. 
Bangud sa indi pag-operate sang pila ka daku nga power plants sa Visayas kag limitado nga kuryente nga halin sa Mindanao, nagnubo ang available nga power supply sa Visayas Grid.
Suno sa NGCP, ang Visayas Grid yara sa:
 RED ALERT:
•3:00 PM – 9:00 PM
 YELLOW ALERT: 
•1:00 PM – 2:00 PM
•2:00 PM – 3:00 PM
•9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Bangud sini, magapatuman ang NGCP sang Manual Load Dropping (MLD) para mapabilin nga stable kag masaligan ang power grid. Ini mahimo magresulta sa temporaryo nga pagkawala sang kuryente sa pila ka lugar sa franchise area ni MORE Power.
Sa subong, indi pa maka-post ang MORE Power sang mga feeders nga posible maapektuhan. Magadepende ini sa load reduction nga ipangayo sang NGCP.
Padayon kami nga naga-monitor kag coordinate sa NGCP para makahatag sang update sa gilayon kung may bag-o nga impormasyon.
Nagapangayo kami sang inyo pasensya, paghangop, kag kooperasyon. Salamat.
To know more about MLD: https://www.facebook.com/watch/?ref=search...

Factor/s that contributed to the RED and YELLOW Alert declarations:
1. Unavailability of Visayas' large coal plants TVI 1, TVI 2, and PEDC 3

𝐌𝐎𝐑𝐄 𝐏𝐎𝐖𝐄𝐑 𝐀𝐃𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐎𝐑𝐘: 𝐌𝐀𝐍𝐔𝐀𝐋 𝐋𝐎𝐀𝐃 𝐃𝐑𝐎𝐏𝐏𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐁𝐘 𝐍𝐆𝐂𝐏
Date: September 10, 2026 (Thursday)
As of 8:40 PM, MORE Power announces the complete restoration of all feeders affected by the Manual Load Dropping (MLD) implemented by NGCP in the Visayas Grid due to Red and Yellow Alert Status caused by a power supply deficiency.
Affected Areas:
• DIVERSION FEEDER 2
• LA PAZ FEEDER 1
• DIVERSION FEEDER 1
• JARO FEEDER 1
• LA PAZ FEEDER 7
• DIVERSION FEEDER 3
• LA PAZ FEEDER 5
• MOLO FEEDER 3
• MEGAWORLD FEEDER 6
• MOBILE FEEDER 3
Please be advised that the Visayas Grid remains under Yellow Alert Status until 10:00 PM. However, as of this time, power supply within our franchise area has normalized. MORE Power continues to closely monitor the situation to help maintain system stability and ensure reliable service to our consumers.
Thank you for your patience, understanding and cooperation
